map.网站收录靠 sitemap 告诉爬虫有哪些页面。填入全部 URL（每行一个），本: Search engines discover your pages through a sitemap that lists what to crawl. Paste all URLs (one per line) and this tool generates a sitemap-protocol XML; save it as sitemap.xml.
map.生成供搜索引擎抓取的 XML Sitemap。: Generate an XML Sitemap for search engines to crawl.
map.：每个 URL 含 loc（地址）、lastmod（最后修改）、changefr: : Each URL contains loc (address), lastmod (last modified), changefreq (update frequency), and priority.
map.：单个 sitemap 最多 5 万条 URL、未压缩不超过 50MB；超出需用: : A single sitemap holds up to 50,000 URLs and 50MB uncompressed; beyond that, use a sitemap index to split it.
map.：在 robots.txt 中声明 Sitemap 地址，或通过搜索引擎站长平台: : Declare the Sitemap location in robots.txt, or submit it via the search-engine webmaster console.
map.：sitemap 只是抓取线索，不保证收录；priority 仅供搜索引擎参考。: : A sitemap is only a crawl hint and does not guarantee indexing; priority is merely advisory to search engines.
map.URL 列表（每行一个，含 https://）: URL list (one per line, including https://)
map.单 sitemap 最多 50000 条 URL 且文件不超过 50MB；超限需: A single sitemap holds at most 50,000 URLs and must not exceed 50MB; beyond that, split it with a sitemap index file.
map.URL 必须是绝对地址且可被爬虫访问；含非 ASCII 需做百分号编码。: URLs must be absolute and reachable by crawlers; non-ASCII characters need percent-encoding.
map.生成后放到站点根目录并在 robots.txt 声明 Sitemap 路径，再到: After generating, place it at the site root, declare the Sitemap path in robots.txt, then submit it in the search-engine console.
map.列出站点 URL 生成 sitemap.xml。: List your site URLs to generate sitemap.xml.
map.新站上线前整理 URL 清单：把已确认可访问的页面列出来生成 sitemap.x: Before launching a new site, compile a URL inventory: list confirmed reachable pages to generate sitemap.xml and submit it to search engines to speed up indexing.
map.单文件 5 万 URL / 50MB，超出需索引。: 50,000 URLs / 50MB per file; beyond that, use an index.
map.生成的 sitemap 一定能被收录吗？: Will the generated sitemap definitely get indexed?
map.不能保证。sitemap 只是「告知」而非「命令」——搜索引擎会自行判断是否抓取: No guarantee. A sitemap is a 'notice', not a 'command'—search engines decide whether to crawl and index on their own; pages blocked by robots, returning non-200, or of low quality will not be indexed even if listed. So first ensure pages are reachable with unique value, and keep the sitemap consistent with the actual state.
map.按换行切分输入，逐行去首尾空白后只保留以 http 或 https 协议开头的行: Splits the input on newlines, trims each line, and keeps only lines starting with the http or https protocol; when none remain it prompts to paste one URL per line starting with a protocol. It takes the current date (the first 10 characters of the ISO string) as lastmod, generates a url node with the address and lastmod for each URL, and wraps them with the XML declaration and the sitemap namespace declaration in a root node. It outputs the total URL count and shows the whole XML escaped in a code block
